title: 季節のあいさつ(二頭身)
lead: 新年・お礼・お見舞いなど、季節のあいさつの場面を二頭身のキャラクターで12点描きました。挨拶状やおたよりの挿絵に使えます。
subject_en: the SAME two cute original chibi characters in turn (a boy with short black hair and a girl with a brown bob), two-heads-tall proportions, big head, small body, simple dot eyes, rosy cheeks, thick dark-brown closed outline, flat colours, plain clothes without any logo. Each item shows one or two of them. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: both bowing politely in winter coats beside a small pine decoration
the girl bowing with a small gift box in both hands
the boy holding a small bouquet
both holding a watermelon slice and a paper fan
the girl waving with one arm open
both bowing deeply with a small sweat drop
the boy smiling with both hands raised
the girl in pyjamas holding a pillow
the boy holding out a ribboned gift
